c2.label: Constellation 2 Elemental Mastery
c2.reason: Adds Elemental Mastery only, which none of his counted hits use.

c6.label: Constellation 6 after Skill or Burst
c6.reason: A Constellation 6 window of 5 seconds after his Skill or Burst covers only part of his Normal, Charged and Plunging Attacks. It gives them an Anemo infusion and a bonus from his Elemental Mastery, both counted when it is switched on here; it was checked once with it on against Genshin Optimizer.

swirlcryo.label: Swirled Cryo
swirlcryo.reason: A bonus for the party's Cryo damage after he swirls Cryo, which reaches none of his counted hits.

swirlelectro.label: Swirled Electro
swirlelectro.reason: A bonus for the party's Electro damage after he swirls Electro, which reaches none of his counted hits.

swirlhydro.label: Swirled Hydro
swirlhydro.reason: A bonus for the party's Hydro damage after he swirls Hydro, which reaches none of his counted hits.

swirlpyro.label: Swirled Pyro
swirlpyro.reason: A bonus for the party's Pyro damage after he swirls Pyro, which reaches none of his counted hits.
